title: Everyone’s making money off ‘GTA 6’ this week — except investors in Take-Two’s stock
html:
‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ might be a blockbuster game, but investors are shrugging it off

Take-Two Interactive’s “Grand Theft Auto VI” might be one of the biggest entertainment events ever, but investors haven’t been impressed.

Shares of Take-Two TTWO — which owns Rockstar Games, the developer of ”GTA 6” — are down around 8% over the past five days. While shares rallied on Wednesday, a day before the videogame’s official release, they fell Thursday and rose just fractionally on Friday after official sales figures dropped.
summary: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ might be a blockbuster game, but investors are shrugging it off.
